visual_identity.core_identity: A stealth-focused bugbear using its long reach and shaggy outline to move silently through cramped underground spaces.
visual_identity.silhouette: Tall crouched figure compressed into a low passage, very long arms, shaggy shoulders, one hand signaling silence.
visual_identity.head_features: Broad goblinoid face, small watchful eyes, pointed ears, coarse hair framing the head.
visual_identity.body_shape: Long-limbed powerful humanoid folded into a stealthy crouch, with oversized hands and feet.
visual_identity.surface: Sparse shaggy fur patches and simple hide surfaces without dense texture.

accuracy_checks: scene stays simple enough to color

reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.
